title: New-Service Loading in the Replenishment Floor of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
A recently activated Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service carries a loading on its replenishment floor.

**Clause.** A service activated fewer than 2 whole months before today adds 10 percent, one activated fewer than 6 whole months before today adds 5 percent, and any other service adds nothing for its age, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

The activation date is the date on the service record on which business verification and the first deposit activated the service.

| Whole months from activation to today | Loading |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 10 percent |
| 2 to 5 | 5 percent |
| 6 or more | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, activated on the 14th of a month)

- Today the 13th, two calendar months later: 1 whole month, 10 percent.
- Today the 14th, two calendar months later: 2 whole months, 5 percent.
- Today the 13th, six calendar months later: 5 whole months, 5 percent.
- Today the 14th, six calendar months later: 6 whole months, nothing.
